decision_contract.environment_failure: Any original program is not definitively FALSE, the pinned source/hash contract fails, or UAutomizer cannot return a definitive verdict for every required original control.
decision_contract.soundness_violation: At least one side_effect_attack is accepted by the pinned public parser/filter and produces original=FALSE, assume=TRUE, assert=TRUE, aggregate=TRUE.
decision_contract.strict_purity_mitigation: All pure controls accepted, all syntax/side-effect cases rejected, and no purity-accepted row yields a false-safe aggregate.
decision_contract.systematic_violation: At least two distinct side-effect mechanisms satisfy soundness_violation on at least two program templates each.
